description: Branch name of the train's wake channel in the forge (refs/heads/<name>), moved forward only over git like train.lock_ref. With train.trigger_mode wake the producer of pr.ready fast-forwards it with a record {pr, sha, event_id}; its commit history is the wake log the train-role session serves (GATE-ON-PUSH R2). Inert while nobody serves it: the periodic run still merges.
